Erlotinib is metabolised by the liver. UK licensed product information states that although erlotinib exposure was similar in patients with moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh score 7 to 9) compared with those with adequate hepatic function, caution is advised when using erlotinib in hepatic impairment. Dose reduc- tion or interruption of therapy should be considered if adverse effects occur. Use in severe hepatic impairment is not recom- mended due to a lack of data. UK licensed product information also states that no dose adjust- ments appear necessary in patients with mild to moderate renal impairment, but that use of erlotinib in patients with severe renal impairment is not recommended. There are no data available for patients with a creatinine clearance less than 15 mL/minute or those with a serum creatinine concentration greater than 1.5 times the upper normal limit.
